_README: TEMPLATE for .private_targets.json -- the leak-target list used by
check_private_data.py and build_complete_public_release.py.
THIS FILE IS TRACKED AND MUST STAY EMPTY. It documents the schema only.
It NEVER contains real private data.
HOW TO USE IT
1. Copy it:   cp .private_targets.template.json .private_targets.json
2. Fill in YOUR OWN private values in the lists below.
3. .private_targets.json is gitignored, so your values never leave the machine.
WHAT GOES IN EACH LIST
names    legal-name variants that are NOT your public authorship name
phones   phone numbers, any formatting (the scrubber builds the variants)
handles  messaging / social handles, with or without a leading '@'
emails   e-mail addresses
IF YOU LEAVE IT EMPTY (or never create .private_targets.json at all)
build_complete_public_release.py runs in NO-TARGETS MODE: it still forces
push-able secrets, still redacts key-shaped values, and still audits the
built package -- it simply has no personal values to hunt for. That is the
correct behaviour for a fresh clone, a public contributor, and Tlamatini
rebuilding herself from TlamatiniSourceCode/.
The builder REFUSES no-targets mode when it finds evidence that this tree
DOES hold maintainer private data (data.keys, contacts.private.json, a
non-empty contacts.json) -- that combination means the file went missing
by accident, and shipping unscrubbed would be the worse outcome.
